errors.evidence: The description incorrectly transcribes the genre for the poem "蜀道难" as "七言乐府" (seven-character Yuefu), but the image clearly shows it as "七古乐府" (seven-character ancient Yuefu).
The description transcribes the poem title as "无题二首·二" using a middle dot, but the title in the image is written as "无题二首二" without the dot.
The description claims the bars have a darker blue outline, but the bars in the image appear to be solid light blue without a distinct, intentionally drawn darker outline.
